notes: Three taḥwīl branches («ح»); the second writes no name after الحسين بن حفص, and the first and third name Talha bin Yahya

«كلاهما عن سفيان الثوري، عن طلحة بن يحيى» is written once after the two co-transmitters; the third branch is read as Ishaq and Muhammad b. Yusuf both leading to Sufyan, so the route runs through them in this order; «بإسناد وكيع نحو حديثه» is a back_reference at the end of that route
